title: Solve a system of two linear equations by graphing

sections.skill: Solve a system of two linear equations by graphing

questions.skill: Solve a system of two linear equations by graphing
questions.response: draw on the figure and write an answer
questions.prompt: Graph y = x + 1 and y = -x + 5 on the grid. What is the solution of the system?
questions.prompt_markup:
Graph y = x + 1 and y = -x + 5 on the grid.
What is the solution of the system?
questions.drawing_answer: The line y = x + 1 through (0, 1) and (4, 5), and the line y = -x + 5 through (0, 5) and (5, 0), crossing at (2, 3)
questions.grading_note: Grade both: the two lines drawn correctly, and the solution (2, 3).

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 6 and y from 0 to 6. x-axis label "x", y-axis label "y". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.
